arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_stress.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Stress tests: maximal output, memory, adversarial strings, odd framing."""
import json, resource, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import run_raw, run, Checks, prof, query, rec

c = Checks()

def run_measure(raw):
    """Run and return (rc, out, err, child peak RSS in MiB)."""
    before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=raw, capture_output=True, timeout=200)
    after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr, max(after, before) / 1024.0, time.time() - t0

ERR = b'{"error":"invalid-input"}\n'

# --- framing oddities -------------------------------------------------------
c.check('utf8 bom rejected', run_raw(b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}')[1] == ERR)
c.check('crlf whitespace ok',
        run_raw(b'{\r\n"zones":\t[],\r\n"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":4,'
                b'"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],\r\n"observations":[]\r\n}')[1].startswith(b'{"runs"'))
c.check('raw newline inside string rejected',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":"a\\nb.","type":"A","data":"1.2.3.4"}]}],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]')[1] == ERR)
c.check('crlf inside txt data rejected',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":"a.","type":"TXT","data":"x\\ry"}]}],"profiles":[],'
                b'"queries":[],"observations":[]')[1] == ERR)
c.check('lone surrogate in txt rejected',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":"a.","type":"TXT","data":"\\ud800"}]}],"profiles":[],'
                b'"queries":[],"observations":[]')[1] == ERR)
c.check('lone surrogate in name rejected',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":"\\ud800.","records":[]}],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]')[1] == ERR)
c.check('nul byte in txt rejected',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":"a.","type":"TXT","data":"x\\u0000y"}]}],"profiles":[],'
                b'"queries":[],"observations":[]')[1] == ERR)
c.check('tab escape in txt rejected',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":"a.","type":"TXT","data":"x\\ty"}]}],"profiles":[],'
                b'"queries":[],"observations":[]')[1] == ERR)
c.check('space and tilde are legal txt ends',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":"a.","type":"TXT","data":" ~"}]}],"profiles":[],'
                b'"queries":[],"observations":[]')[1] == ERR)  # rejected only because profiles is empty
c.check('space and tilde accepted with a profile',
        run_raw(b'{"zones":[{"origin":".","records":[{"owner":"a.","type":"TXT","data":" ~"}]}],'
                b'"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":4,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],'
                b'"queries":[],"observations":[]}')[1].startswith(b'{"runs"'))

# --- adversarial strings versus the depth scanner -------------------------
nasty = ''.join('"\\[\\]{}"' * 32)          # 256 chars of bracket/quote soup
big_nasty = ('"' + '[' * 40 + '{' * 40 + '\\\\' + '"' * 3 + '}' * 40 + ']' * 40 + '"')[:256]
for label, payload in [('bracket soup', nasty), ('escape soup', big_nasty)]:
    doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'z%d.test.' % i, 'records': [
                        rec('o%d.z%d.test.' % (j, i), 'TXT', payload) for j in range(63)]}
                      for i in range(16)],
           'profiles': [prof('p%d' % i, 64) for i in range(8)],
           'queries': [query('q%d' % k, 'w.z0.test.'[:0] + 'x.z0.test.', 'TXT', k + 1) for k in range(20)],
           'observations': [{'id': 'o%d' % o, 'query': 'q0', 'profile': 'p0',
                             'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                        'answer': [rec('a%d.b.c.' % j, 'TXT', payload)
                                                   for j in range(128)]}} for o in range(64)]}
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    rc, out, err, rss, elapsed = run_measure(raw)
    c.check('depth scanner tolerant of %s' % label, rc == 0 and out.startswith(b'{"runs":'),
            '%r %r %r' % (rc, out[:80], err[:200]))

# --- maximal valid document: long chains, big rrsets, big table ------------
records = []
# 64-hop CNAME chain plus a 64-record terminal RRset in one zone, repeated for several zones
for zi in range(15):
    for i in range(63):
        records.append(rec('n%d.z%d.test.' % (i, zi), 'CNAME', 'n%d.z%d.test.' % (i + 1, zi)))
    for j in range(61):
        records.append(rec('n63.z%d.test.' % zi, 'TXT', 'v' * 256))
records.append(rec('n63.z14.test.', 'CNAME', 'n63.z13.test.'))
records.append(rec('n63.z13.test.', 'CNAME', 'n63.z12.test.'))
c.check('records <= 1024', len(records) <= 1024, len(records))
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'z0.test.', 'records': records[:512]},
                 {'origin': 'z7.test.', 'records': records[512:]}],
       'profiles': [prof('p%d' % i, 64) for i in range(8)],
       'queries': [query('q%d' % k, 'n%d.z0.test.' % (k % 3), 'TXT', k + 1) for k in range(20)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o%d' % o, 'query': 'q0', 'profile': 'p%d' % (o % 8),
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('e%d.f.example.' % j, 'TXT', 'w' * 256)
                                               for j in range(128)]}} for o in range(64)]}
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
rc, out, err, rss, elapsed = run_measure(raw)
print('maximal document: in=%d out=%d rss=%.0fMiB %.2fs' % (len(raw), len(out), rss, elapsed))
c.check('maximal document accepted', rc == 0 and out.startswith(b'{"runs":'), '%r %r' % (rc, out[:80]))
c.check('output under 32MiB cap', len(out) < 32 << 20, len(out))
c.check('stderr empty', err == b'', err[:200])
c.check('peak child RSS under 512MiB', rss < 300, rss)
c.check('runtime under 30s', elapsed < 25, elapsed)

# --- whole-document garbage / very long single-line input ------------------
rc, out, err = run_raw(b'x' * (2 << 20))
c.check('2MiB of junk rejected', rc == 0 and out == ERR, '%r %r' % (rc, out[:40]))
rc, out, err = run_raw(b'[' * (4 << 20))
c.check('4MiB of open brackets rejected', rc == 0 and out == ERR, '%r %r' % (rc, out[:40]))
rc, out, err = run_raw(b'{"zones":[' + b'[],' * (1 << 20) + b']}')
c.check('1M nested-ish arrays rejected', rc == 0 and out == ERR, '%r %r' % (rc, out[:40]))
rc, out, err = run_raw(b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}' * 100)
c.check('duplicate documents rejected', rc == 0 and out == ERR, '%r %r' % (rc, out[:40]))

sys.exit(c.done('stress tests'))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tests/test_stress.py; echo "exit=$?"
